arxiv-2105-05865.title: Edge density of bulk states due to relativity
arxiv-2105-05865.creator: Matthew D. Horner, Jiannis K. Pachos
arxiv-2105-05865.description: Abstract The boundaries of quantum materials can host a variety of exotic effects such as topologically robust edge states or anyonic quasiparticles. Here, we show that fermionic systems such as graphene that admit a low energy Dirac description can exhibit counterintuitive relativistic effects at their boundaries.

arxiv-2204-04473.title: WHITE DWARFS IN A UNIFORM SPHERE APPROXIMATION, WITH GENERAL RELATIVITY EFFECTS TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT
arxiv-2204-04473.creator: G. S. Bisnovatyi-Kogan, Е.А. Патраман
arxiv-2204-04473.description: Abstract The limiting mass of cold white dwarfs was first calculated by E. Stoner in an approximate model of a uniform star and was soon reduced by 20an exact solution of the equations for the stellar equilibrium. Here we examine uniform models of white dwarfs taking general relativity effects and the influence of finite temperature into account.

arxiv-2307-12238.title: Dust Scattered Radiation in the Galactic Poles
arxiv-2307-12238.creator: Jayant Murthy 1,*, R. C. Henry 2, James Overduin 3
arxiv-2307-12238.description: Abstract We have modeled the diffuse background at the Galactic Poles in the far-ultraviolet (FUV: 1536 Å) and the near-ultraviolet (NUV: 2316 Å). The background is well-fit using a single-scattering dust model with an offset representing the extragalactic light plus any other contribution to the diffuse background. We have found a dust albedo of 0.35 – 0.40 (FUV) and 0.

arxiv-2412-03332.title: On Approximability of ℓ 2 2 \ell_{2}^{2} Min-Sum Clustering
arxiv-2412-03332.creator: Karthik C. S, Euiwoong Lee, Yuval Rabani, Chris Schwiegelshohn, Samson Zhou
arxiv-2412-03332.description: Abstract The ℓ 2 2 \ell_{2}^{2} min-sum k k -clustering problem is to partition an input set into clusters C 1 , … , C k C_{1},\ldots,C_{k} to minimize ∑ i = 1 k ∑ p , q ∈ C i ‖ p − q ‖ 2 2 \sum_{i=1}^{k}\sum_{p,q\in C_{i}}\|p-q\|_{2}^{2} .

arxiv-2502-15654.title: Machine-generated text detection prevents language model collapse
arxiv-2502-15654.creator: George Drayson, Emine Yilmaz and Vasileios Lampos
arxiv-2502-15654.description: Abstract As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly prevalent, their generated outputs are proliferating across the web, risking a future where machine-generated content dilutes human-authored text. Since online data is the primary resource for LLM pre-training, subsequent models could be trained on an unknown portion of synthetic samples.

arxiv-2511-12714.title: Shortcutting for Negative-Weight Shortest Paths
arxiv-2511-12714.creator: George Z. Li, Jason Li, Satish Rao, Junkai Zhang
arxiv-2511-12714.description: Abstract Consider the single-source shortest paths problem on a directed graph with real-valued edge weights. We solve this problem in O ⁡ ( n 2.5 ​ log 4.5 ​ n ) O(n^{2.5}\log^{4.5}n) time, improving on prior work of Fineman (STOC 2024) and Huang-Jin-Quanrud (SODA 2025, 2026) on dense graphs.

pmc-11301982.title: A decade of change towards Value-Based Health Care at a Dutch University Hospital: a complexity-informed process study
pmc-11301982.creator: Veerle van Engen, Martina Buljac-Samardzic, Rob Baatenburg de Jong, Jeffrey Braithwaite, Kees Ahaus, Monique Den Hollander-Ardon, Ingrid Peters, Igna Bonfrer
pmc-11301982.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundWhile healthcare organizations in several countries are embracing Value-Based Health Care (VBHC), there are limited insights into how to achieve this paradigm shift. This study examines the decade-long (2012–2023) change towards VBHC in a pioneering Dutch university hospital.MethodThrough retrospective, complexity-informed process research, we study how a Dutch university hospital’s strategy to implement VBHC evolved, how implementation outcomes unfolded, and the underlying logic behind these developments.

pmc-11541034.title: Effect of supplemented paprika oleoresin solution on the physicochemical properties and shelf-life of boiled pork sausages with nitrite reduction
pmc-11541034.creator: Geon Ho Kim, Koo Bok Chin
pmc-11541034.description: ObjectiveThis study was performed to evaluate the quality characteristics of reduced-nitrite boiled pork sausages (BPSs) with paprika oleoresin solution (POS) to compensate for the reduced sodium nitrite (NaNO2).MethodsPOS was prepared by diluting paprika oleoresin with sunflower seed oil at a ratio of 1:20.

pmc-12577159.title: The correlation between systemic inflammatory index and rebleeding after bronchial artery embolization: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12577159.creator: Rong Lu, Yujia Gao, Changhao Sun, Minglei Wang, Ting Huang, Guanhua Yang, Yong Chen
pmc-12577159.description: ObjectiveInflammation and immune-related factors may play a crucial role in recurrent hemoptysis after bronchial artery embolization (BAE). This study aimed to investigate the relationship between inflammatory markers such as neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio (LMR), neutrophil-to-monocyte ratio (NMR), systemic immune-inflammatory index (SII), and pan-immune- inflammatory value (PIV) and recurrent hemoptysis after BAE.

pmc-12749480.title: Proposing a novel structure for the implementation of a graphene metamaterial-based tunable band pass/stop spatial THz plasmonic filter
pmc-12749480.creator: Pooria Kabiri, Amir saman Nooramin
pmc-12749480.description: We propose a tunable multi-layer graphene surface plasmonic filter in the terahertz band. In this work, we can set the filter type, operation frequency, and pass/stop bandwidth by properly selecting the chemical potential of graphene. Also, higher-order filters are analyzed by cascading multiple filters.

pmc-13061459.title: A Survey to Evaluate the Knowledge and Attitude of Anesthesiology Resident Doctors towards Perioperative Pain Assessment in Children
pmc-13061459.creator: Snigdha Singh, Anju R. Bhalotra, Rahil Singh, Shweta Dhiman
pmc-13061459.description: Background:Pain assessment in children is often inconsistent despite its recognition as the “fifth vital sign.” Untreated perioperative pain has adverse physiological and psychological effects. Although validated tools exist, their use in clinical practice remains limited. This survey evaluated the knowledge of anesthesiology residents towards pediatric pain assessment.

pmc-13398757.title: Integrated Metabolomics and Selection Signal Analysis Provide Insights Into the Selection for Flavonol Biosynthesis Associated With Lettuce Quality Improvement
pmc-13398757.creator: Xiao Yang, Shiwei Wei, Ge Jin, Li Zhang, Ran Du, Yajun Wang, Chengcheng Shen, Tao Huang, Guotao Huo, Jie Peng, Bo Song, Fangyuan Zhang, Victor Hugo Escalona Contreras, Lijun Luo, Yuejian Li, Francisco A Tomas‐Barberan, Bin Liu, Qichang Yang
pmc-13398757.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Lettuce is a critical leafy vegetable consumed worldwide and is a substantial dietary source of health‐promoting compounds. Exploring changes in metabolism during lettuce domestication under artificial selection conditions is important to facilitate further breeding and cultivation for quality improvement. A liquid chromatography‐mass spectrometry‐based metabolomics approach was used to putatively identify 237 metabolites from 40 accessions, of which 130 were identified as metabolite identification level 1.

pmc-13408605.title: Hybrid Operating Room Applications in Otolaryngology: A Seven-Year Single-Center Experience with Image-Guided and Multidisciplinary Procedures
pmc-13408605.creator: Tzu-Chen Huang, Hao-Chun Hung, Shu-Wei Yeh, Chang-Yo Pan, Mei-Wen Nian, Iva Lin, Chung-Hsiung Chen, Stella Chin-Shaw Tsai
pmc-13408605.description: Background/Objectives: Hybrid operating rooms combine advanced intraoperative imaging, endovascular capabilities, and multidisciplinary resources within a single procedural environment. However, their use in otolaryngology remains insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated institutional patterns of hybrid operating room use, principal clinical indications, multidisciplinary involvement, and perioperative resource utilization in otolaryngology.

pmc-13640117.title: Association of immunohistochemistry-based molecular subtypes with adnexal involvement in endometrial cancer
pmc-13640117.creator: Oğuz Kaan Köksal, Hande Nur Öncü, Firdevs Şahin Duran, Şahin Kaan Baydemir, Neslihan Öztürk, Gökçen Ege, Candost Hanedan, Vakkas Korkmaz
pmc-13640117.description: BackgroundAdnexal involvement in endometrial cancer is traditionally regarded as an anatomical spread pattern within FIGO stage IIIA; however, its biological heterogeneity remains incompletely understood. The 2023 FIGO staging system distinguishes between favorable “synchronous” ovarian involvement (stage IA3) and true metastatic spread to the ovary (stage IIIA1), highlighting the biological heterogeneity of adnexal involvement.

pmc-13677036.title: Building climate-resilient health systems for the displaced: health information systems and the statistical invisibility of climate-related mobility in sub-Saharan Africa
pmc-13677036.creator: R Leone, Y Ouattara, L Tognaccini, W Ricciardi, MR Gualano
pmc-13677036.description: BackgroundClimate change is reshaping the populations health systems serve, yet health information systems (HIS) remain blind to one of the fastest-growing groups: people displaced or migrating in the context of climate change. In sub-Saharan Africa this mobility is now counted at scale, but mobility data and health data systems have developed as parallel infrastructures blind to each other's populations.
